name.description: Name of the experiment. It should be a unique name if you want to run a new experiment. If you enable auto resume, the experiment with this name will be resumed instead of starting a new training run.

scale.description: Scale of the model. Most architectures support a scale of 1, 2, 3, 4, or 8. A scale of 1 can be used for restoration models that don't change the resolution of the input image. A scale of 2 means the width and height of the input image are doubled, so a 640x480 input will be upscaled to 1280x960.

num_gpu.description: The number of GPUs to use for training, if using multiple GPUs.

model_type.description: Training model integration. Use sdg for joint DRFT, Gaussian splatting, one-step residual-flow, and optional GAN training.

network_g_teacher.description: The options for the teacher generator model.

network_d.description: The options for the discriminator model.

network_ae.description: The options for the autoencoder model.

manual_seed.description: Random seed for training, useful for removing randomness when testing the effect of different settings.

deterministic.description: Enables torch.use_deterministic_algorithms. Slows down training, only use when reproducibility is critical.

deterministic_warn_only.description: When deterministic mode is enabled, warn instead of failing on an operation without a deterministic implementation.

use_amp.description: Speed up training and reduce VRAM usage. NVIDIA only.

amp_bf16.description: Use bf16 instead of fp16 for AMP, RTX 3000 series or newer only. Only recommended if fp16 doesn't work.

use_channels_last.description: Enable channels last memory format while using AMP. Reduces VRAM and speeds up training for most architectures, but some architectures are slower with channels last.

use_compile.description: Enable torch.compile for the generator model. The first matching graph still pays compilation and autotuning cost, while architectures with precompile-cache support persist compiled forward/backward artifacts for much faster matching resumes.

compile_discriminator.description: Compile the GAN discriminator with compile_mode. This is independent of use_compile so the generator and discriminator can be controlled separately.

compile_mode.description: Mode to use with torch.compile. See https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.compile.html for more info.

detect_anomaly.description: Whether or not to enable anomaly detection, which can be useful for debugging NaNs that occur during training. Has a significant performance hit and should be disabled when not debugging.

high_order_degradation.description: Whether or not to enable OTF (on the fly) degradations, which generates LRs on the fly.

high_order_degradations_debug.description: Whether or not to enable debugging for OTF, which saves the OTF generated LR images so they can be inspected to view the effect of different OTF settings.

high_order_degradations_debug_limit.description: The maximum number of OTF images to save when debugging is enabled.

dataroot_lq_prob.description: Probability of using paired LR data instead of OTF LR data.

otf_degradation_combos.description: List of degradation combinations. Each combo is a list of degradation names. One combo is selected per iteration (mutually exclusive). Valid names: ntsc, rainbow, ghosting, interlace, scanline, lowpass, overshoot, shift, subsampling, dithering, compress, hf_noise, nlmeans. If null, all degradations are eligible independently (default behavior).

otf_degradation_combo_weights.description: Relative weights for each combo in otf_degradation_combos. Higher weight = more likely to be selected. Does not need to sum to 1. Must match length of otf_degradation_combos. Null = equal weights.

otf_no_combo_weight.description: Probability (0-1) that no combo is selected and only global degradations apply. 0 = always pick a combo, 0.5 = 50% chance of no combo, 1.0 = never pick a combo.

otf_global_degradations.description: Degradations that are always eligible regardless of which combo is selected. Valid names: same as otf_degradation_combos. If null, no degradations are globally enabled (only combo degradations apply). Upstream degradations (blur, resize, noise, jpeg) are always active.

otf_hf_noise_normalize.description: Whether to zero-center and normalize the high-frequency noise field before scaling it. Disable to use the raw `(beta - 0.5) * 2 * alpha` style field.

otf_hf_noise_prob.description: Probability of adding the same shared high-frequency noise field to both GT and LQ after the final OTF crop, between 0 and 1.

otf_hf_noise_alpha_range.description: Amplitude range for the high-frequency noise field, in the format `[min_alpha, max_alpha]`.

otf_hf_noise_beta_shape_range.description: Range used to sample the beta `a` shape parameter, and also the `b` shape parameter when no `otf_hf_noise_beta_offset_range` is set.

otf_hf_noise_beta_offset_range.description: Optional positive offset range used to derive `b = a + offset` instead of sampling `b` independently. Use `[1, 5]` to approximate the external hf_noise snippet more closely.

otf_hf_noise_gray_prob.description: Probability that the high-frequency noise field is grayscale and broadcast to all channels, between 0 and 1.

otf_hf_noise_denoise_lq.description: Whether to apply GPU Non-Local Means denoising to the LQ before the final resize. Removes existing noise so the model learns to produce clean output with HF texture from GT.

otf_hf_noise_denoise_strength.description: NLMeans filter strength (h parameter) on a 0-255 scale. Higher = more smoothing. Only used when otf_hf_noise_denoise_lq is true.

dithering_prob.description: Probability of applying dithering to the LQ, between 0 and 1. Applied after crop as the last degradation step.

dithering_types.description: List of dithering algorithms to choose from. Options: quantize, floydsteinberg, jarvisjudiceninke, stucki, atkinson, burkes, sierra, tworowsierra, sierralite, order, riemersma.

dithering_quantize_range.description: Range of quantization levels per channel for dithering, in the format `[min_levels, max_levels]`.

dithering_map_size.description: List of map sizes to choose from for ordered dithering.

dithering_history_range.description: Range of history values for Riemersma dithering.

dithering_ratio_range.description: Range of decay ratio values for Riemersma dithering.

dithering_palette_mode.description: Probability of using palette-based (indexed color) quantization instead of uniform per-channel. 0.0 = always uniform, 1.0 = always palette, 0.5 = 50/50 mix. Palette mode extracts a content-adaptive palette via median cut, like GIF/PNG8. When palette mode fires, dithering_palette_size controls the number of colors instead of dithering_quantize_range.

dithering_palette_size.description: Range of palette colors (2-256) when palette mode is enabled. E.g. [64, 256] for 64-256 color indexed dithering.

shift_prob.description: Probability of applying channel shift to the LQ, between 0 and 1. Applied before the first resize.

shift_types.description: List of color spaces to apply shift in. One is randomly selected. Options: rgb, yuv, cmyk.

shift_percent.description: If true, shift amounts are percentages of image dimensions. If false, shift amounts are in pixels.

shift_rgb_r.description: Shift range for R channel: [[x_min, x_max], [y_min, y_max]].

shift_rgb_g.description: Shift range for G channel: [[x_min, x_max], [y_min, y_max]].

shift_rgb_b.description: Shift range for B channel: [[x_min, x_max], [y_min, y_max]].

shift_yuv_y.description: Shift range for Y channel (YUV): [[x_min, x_max], [y_min, y_max]].

shift_yuv_u.description: Shift range for U channel (YUV): [[x_min, x_max], [y_min, y_max]].

shift_yuv_v.description: Shift range for V channel (YUV): [[x_min, x_max], [y_min, y_max]].

shift_cmyk_c.description: Shift range for C channel (CMYK): [[x_min, x_max], [y_min, y_max]].

shift_cmyk_m.description: Shift range for M channel (CMYK): [[x_min, x_max], [y_min, y_max]].

shift_cmyk_y.description: Shift range for Y channel (CMYK): [[x_min, x_max], [y_min, y_max]].

shift_cmyk_k.description: Shift range for K channel (CMYK): [[x_min, x_max], [y_min, y_max]].

subsampling_prob.description: Probability of applying chroma subsampling to the LQ, between 0 and 1. Applied before the first resize.

subsampling_down_algorithms.description: List of downscaling algorithms to choose from for subsampling. Options: nearest, box, hermite, linear, lagrange, cubic_catrom, cubic_mitchell, cubic_bspline, lanczos, gauss.

subsampling_up_algorithms.description: List of upscaling algorithms to choose from for subsampling.

subsampling_formats.description: List of chroma subsampling formats to choose from. Options: 4:4:4, 4:2:2, 4:1:1, 4:2:0, 4:1:0, 4:4:0, 4:2:1, 4:1:2, 4:1:3.

subsampling_blur_range.description: Optional Gaussian blur sigma range for chroma channels after subsampling, in the format `[min_sigma, max_sigma]`. Null to disable.

subsampling_ycbcr_type.description: List of YCbCr standards to choose from. Options: 601, 709, 2020, 240.

ghosting_prob.description: Probability of applying temporal ghosting, between 0 and 1.

ghosting_shift_x.description: Horizontal ghost displacement range [min, max] pixels.

ghosting_shift_y.description: Vertical ghost displacement range [min, max] pixels.

interlace_prob.description: Probability of applying interlace combing, between 0 and 1.

interlace_field_shift.description: Horizontal pixel shift range between fields [min, max].

interlace_dominant_field.description: Field dominance options. One is randomly selected. Options: top, bottom.

lowpass_prob.description: Probability of applying Butterworth lowpass filter, between 0 and 1.

lowpass_cutoff.description: Cutoff frequency range as fraction of Nyquist [min, max]. 1.0 = barely any filtering, 0.3 = heavy.

lowpass_order.description: Butterworth filter order range [min, max]. Higher = sharper rolloff = more ringing.

lowpass_detail_mask.description: If true, protect edges/detail from lowpass using a detail mask computed from HQ.

lowpass_mask_lines_brz.description: Binarize threshold for the edge/lines component of the detail mask.

ntsc_prob.description: Probability of applying NTSC composite simulation, between 0 and 1.

ntsc_preset.description: NTSC preset(s) to randomly select from. Options: broadcast, vhs_sp, vhs_ep.

ntsc_comb_mode.description: Comb filter mode for luma/chroma separation. Options: 2sample, 1h.

ntsc_enable_vhs.description: Enable VHS color-under + luma bandwidth limiting.

ntsc_ghost_delay_us.description: Ghost delay range in microseconds [min, max] (0.5-10).

ntsc_ghost_phase.description: Ghost phase range in degrees [min, max] (0-360).

ntsc_jitter.description: Per-line timing jitter range in subcarrier cycles [min, max] (0-3).

ntsc_edge_ringing.description: Edge ringing (unsharp mask gain) range [min, max] (0-3).

ntsc_vhs_luma_bw.description: VHS luma bandwidth range in MHz [min, max] (1.5-4.2).

ntsc_color_under_bw.description: VHS color-under bandwidth range in kHz [min, max] (200-600).

ntsc_tape_trailing.description: Tape trailing IIR strength range [min, max] (0-1).

ntsc_intensity.description: NTSC effect blend intensity range [min, max] (0=none, 1=full).

overshoot_prob.description: Probability of applying edge overshoot/undershoot, between 0 and 1.

overshoot_amount.description: Sharpening strength range [min, max]. 0 = no effect, 2+ = aggressive.

overshoot_cutoff.description: Butterworth cutoff range as fraction of Nyquist [min, max].

rainbow_prob.description: Probability of applying composite rainbow artifact, between 0 and 1.

rainbow_subcarrier_freq.description: Subcarrier frequency range in cycles/pixel [min, max] (0.15-0.35 typical).

rainbow_chroma_bandwidth.description: Chroma demodulation bandwidth range in cycles/pixel [min, max].

rainbow_intensity.description: Rainbow effect intensity range [min, max] (0-1 blend).

rainbow_phase_alternation.description: If true, subcarrier phase alternates per scanline (NTSC behavior).

scanline_prob.description: Probability of applying CRT scanline darkening, between 0 and 1.

scanline_strength.description: Scanline darkening strength range [min, max] (0 = none, 1 = full black).

scanline_even_lines.description: If true, darken even rows. If false, darken odd rows.

lq_usm.description: Whether to enable unsharp mask on the LQ image.

lq_usm_radius_range.description: For the unsharp mask of the LQ image, use a radius randomly selected from this range.

blur_prob.description: Probability of applying the first blur to the LQ, between 0 and 1.

thicklines_prob.description: Probability of applying custom ThickLines filter to the LQ, between 0 and 1.

resize_prob.description: List of 3 probabilities for the first resize which should add up to 1: the probability of upscaling, the probability of downscaling, and the probability of no resize.

resize_mode_list.description: List of possible resize modes to use for the first resize.

resize_mode_prob.description: List of probabilities for the first resize of selecting the corresponding resize mode in `resize_mode_list`.

resize_range.description: The resize range for the first resize, in the format `[min_resize, max_resize]`.

gaussian_noise_prob.description: The probability of applying the first gaussian noise to the LQ, between 0 and 1.

compress_prob.description: Probability of applying compression in stage 1, between 0 and 1.

compress_algorithms.description: List of compression algorithms to choose from in stage 1. One is randomly selected per iteration. Options: jpeg, webp, h264, hevc, mpeg2, mpeg4, vp9.

compress_algorithm_probs.description: Probability weights for each algorithm in compress_algorithms. Must match length of compress_algorithms.

compress_jpeg_range.description: Quality range for JPEG compression in stage 1 (0-100).

compress_webp_range.description: Quality range for WebP compression in stage 1 (1-100).

compress_h264_range.description: CRF range for H.264 compression in stage 1 (0-51, lower = better).

compress_hevc_range.description: CRF range for HEVC compression in stage 1 (0-51, lower = better).

compress_mpeg2_range.description: qscale range for MPEG-2 compression in stage 1 (1-31, lower = better).

compress_mpeg4_range.description: qscale range for MPEG-4 compression in stage 1 (1-31, lower = better).

compress_vp9_range.description: CRF range for VP9 compression in stage 1 (0-63, lower = better).

compress_video_sampling.description: List of video chroma subsampling options for video codecs in stage 1. Options: 444, 422, 420.

compress_video_sampling_weights.description: Relative weights for each option in compress_video_sampling. Must match length. Null = equal weights (uniform random).

blur_prob2.description: Probability of applying the second blur to the LQ, between 0 and 1.

resize_prob2.description: List of 3 probabilities for the second resize which should add up to 1: the probability of upscaling, the probability of downscaling, and the probability of no resize.

resize_mode_list2.description: List of possible resize modes to use for the second resize.

resize_mode_prob2.description: List of probabilities for the second resize of selecting the corresponding resize mode in `resize_mode_list2`.

resize_range2.description: The resize range for the second resize, in the format `[min_resize, max_resize]`.

gaussian_noise_prob2.description: The probability of applying the second gaussian noise to the LQ, between 0 and 1.

compress_prob2.description: Probability of applying compression in stage 2, between 0 and 1.

compress_algorithms2.description: List of compression algorithms to choose from in stage 2. Same options as compress_algorithms.

compress_algorithm_probs2.description: Probability weights for each algorithm in compress_algorithms2.

compress_jpeg_range2.description: Quality range for JPEG compression in stage 2 (0-100).

compress_webp_range2.description: Quality range for WebP compression in stage 2 (1-100).

compress_h264_range2.description: CRF range for H.264 compression in stage 2.

compress_hevc_range2.description: CRF range for HEVC compression in stage 2.

compress_mpeg2_range2.description: qscale range for MPEG-2 compression in stage 2.

compress_mpeg4_range2.description: qscale range for MPEG-4 compression in stage 2.

compress_vp9_range2.description: CRF range for VP9 compression in stage 2.

compress_video_sampling2.description: List of video chroma subsampling options for video codecs in stage 2.

compress_video_sampling_weights2.description: Relative weights for each option in compress_video_sampling2. Must match length. Null = equal weights (uniform random).

resize_mode_list3.description: List of possible resize modes to use for the final resize.

resize_mode_prob3.description: List of probabilities for the final resize of selecting the corresponding resize mode in `resize_mode_list3`.

queue_size.description: Queue size for OTF processing, must be a multiple of `batch_size_per_gpu`.

pretrain_network_g.description: Path to the pretrain model for the generator. `pth` and `safetensors` formats are supported.

pretrain_network_g_teacher.description: Path to the pretrain model for the teacher of the generator. `pth` and `safetensors` formats are supported.

strict_load_g.description: Whether to load the pretrain model for the generator in strict mode. It should be enabled in most cases, unless you want to partially load a pretrain of a different scale or with slightly different hyperparameters.

pretrain_network_d.description: Path to the pretrain model for the discriminator. `pth` and `safetensors` formats are supported.

strict_load_d.description: Whether to load the pretrain model for the discriminator in strict mode. It should be enabled in most cases.

pretrain_network_ae.description: Path to the pretrain model for the autoencoder. `pth` and `safetensors` formats are supported.

pretrain_network_ae_decoder.description: Path to the pretrain model for the decoder of the autoencoder. `pth` and `safetensors` formats are supported.

name.description: Name of the dataset. It should be unique compared to other datasets in this config, but the exact name isn't very important.

type.description: The type of dataset to use.

num_worker_per_gpu.description: Number of subprocesses to use for data loading with PyTorch dataloader.

batch_size_per_gpu.description: Increasing stabilizes training but going too high can cause issues. Use multiple of 8 for best performance with AMP. A higher batch size, like 32 or 64 is more important when training from scratch, while smaller batches like 8 can be used when training with a quality pretrain model.

accum_iter.description: Using values larger than 1 simulates higher batch size by trading performance for reduced VRAM usage. If accum_iter = 4 and batch_size_per_gpu = 6 then effective batch size = 4 * 6 = 24 but performance may be as much as 4 times as slow.

lq_size.description: During training, a square of this size is cropped from LR images. Larger is usually better but uses more VRAM. Previously gt_size, use lq_size = gt_size / scale to convert. Use multiple of 8 for best performance with AMP.

dataset_enlarge_ratio.description: Increase if the dataset is less than 1000 images to avoid slowdowns. Auto will automatically enlarge small datasets only.

clip_size.description: Number of frames per clip in `PairedVideoDataset`. Must match the `clip_size` option for video generator networks such as `tscunet`.

dataroot_gt.description: Path to the HR (high res) images in your training dataset. Specify one or multiple folders, separated by commas.

target_dataroot_gt.description: Optional path to aligned target HR images used as supervision targets while `dataroot_gt` remains the source for OTF LR synthesis. Must match `dataroot_gt` one-to-one in relative paths.

dataroot_lq.description: Path to the LR (low res) images in your training dataset. Specify one or multiple folders, separated by commas.

paired_dataroot_gt.description: Path to paired HR images for RealESRGANPairedDataset. When set, the paired sub-dataset uses this instead of dataroot_gt, allowing separate folders for OTF and paired training.

forensic_provenance.description: Attach stable source identity to each RealESRGAN training sample so queue-aware forensic capture can attribute a post-degradation batch correctly.

exclude_gt_paths_file.description: Optional newline-delimited list of exact GT paths to exclude before sampling. Intended for a confirmed forensic exclusion set.

filename_tmpl.description: Filename template to use for LR images. Commonly used values might be `{}x2` or `{}x4`, which should be used if the LR dataset filename is in the format filename.png while the LR dataset filename is in the format `filename_x2.png` or `filename_x4.png`. This is common on some research datasets such as DIV2K or DF2K.

total_iter.description: The total number of iterations to train.

adaptive_d.description: Whether the discriminator updates adaptively. That is, discriminator updates are paused whenever the generator falls behind the discriminator (whenever smoothed l_g_gan increases). Can mitigate GAN collapse by preventing the discriminator from overpowering the generator.

optim_g.description: The optimizer to use for the generator model.

distillation.description: Frozen-teacher output and sparse block-feature distillation settings.

ema_decay.description: The decay factor to use for EMA (exponential moving average). Set to 0 to disable EMA.

ema_switch_iter.description: How often to switch EMA model to online model, in iterations. Set to 0 to disable.

ema_foreach.description: Use PyTorch foreach kernels for EMA parameter and buffer updates.

grad_clip.description: Whether or not to enable gradient clipping, which can improve stability when using higher learning rates, but can also cause issues if the grad clip max norm is too small.

grad_clip_max_norm.description: Max norm of gradients for gradient clipping.

gradient_forensics.description: Optional exact replay journal for rare destructive-update research.

warmup_iter.description: Gradually ramp up learning rates until this iteration, to stabilize early training. Use -1 to disable.

restart_scheduler.description: When resuming, if restart_scheduler is true then the scheduler is recreated using the schedule in the training config. If restart_scheduler is false then scheduler is read from saved state and training config schedule is ignored.

scheduler.description: Options for the optimizer scheduler. If there are multiple optimizers, both will use the same scheduler options.

optim_include_params_g.description: Optional regex patterns for generator parameter names to include in the optimizer. If set, only matching trainable parameters are optimized.

optim_exclude_params_g.description: Optional regex patterns for generator parameter names to exclude from the optimizer after inclusion filtering.

optim_d.description: The optimizer to use for the discriminator model.

optim_ae.description: The optimizer to use for the autoencoder model.

losses.description: The list of loss functions to optimize.

sdg_flow_loss_weight.description: Weight of the one-step conditional residual-flow matching loss used by model_type=sdg.

sdg_flow_noise_std.description: Standard deviation of the training-only residual-flow source noise. Inference remains deterministic.

sdg_flow_zero_source_probability.description: Probability of using the deterministic zero residual source during SDG flow training.

sdg_base_loss_weight.description: Weight of the training-only Charbonnier anchor on the internal DRFT base output used by model_type=sdg.

sdg_coarse_loss_weight.description: Weight of the training-only Charbonnier anchor on the DRFT-plus-splat coarse output used by model_type=sdg.

sdg_detach_branch_conditioning.description: Detach DRFT and coarse conditioning at SDG branch inputs so branch losses cannot reshape upstream stages through their conditioning paths.

use_moa.description: Whether to enable mixture of augmentations, which augments the dataset on the fly to create more variety and help the model generalize.

moa_augs.description: The list of augmentations to choose from, only one is selected per iteration.

moa_probs.description: The probability each augmentation in moa_augs will be applied. Total should add up to 1.

moa_debug.description: Save images before and after augment to debug/moa folder inside of the root training directory.

moa_debug_limit.description: The max number of iterations to save augmentation images for.

DistillationOptions.title: DistillationOptions
DistillationOptions.description: Offline knowledge distillation from an immutable pretrained teacher.

output_weight.description: Weight of student regression toward the frozen teacher output.

feature_weight.description: Weight of sparse block-feature distillation. Set to 0 for output-only distillation.

start_iter.description: First iteration at which output distillation is active.

warmup_iters.description: Linear ramp length for output distillation.

feature_start_iter.description: First iteration at which block-feature distillation is active.

feature_warmup_iters.description: Linear ramp length for block-feature distillation.

decay_start_iter.description: Optional iteration at which distillation begins decaying linearly.

end_iter.description: Optional iteration at which all distillation weights reach zero.

feature_transform.description: Feature representation to distill. spatial_affinity implements FAKD-style second-order structural transfer.

feature_pool_size.description: Average-pooling factor applied before spatial-affinity matrices are formed.

epsilon.description: Numerical epsilon for loss and feature normalization.

compile_teacher.description: Compile the frozen teacher whenever use_compile is enabled for the student.

enabled.description: Capture rotating, exact post-queue training windows for destructive-gradient attribution. This is deliberately expensive and should be disabled for normal training.

max_attempts_per_window.description: Maximum attempted batches retained between validation boundaries, including rejected attempts.

retain_windows.description: Number of completed validation windows to retain. Explicit rejection bundles are never rotated.

retain_regressions.description: Number of strongest negative PSNR validation deltas to pin independently of the ordinary rotating windows. No delta threshold or failure classification is applied.

capture_forward_outlier_mae.description: Forensic-only per-sample output MAE trigger. When exceeded, capture a lossless trigger-local model/optimizer state anchor; no batch is rejected or modified.

capture_forward_outlier_max_abs.description: Forensic-only per-sample maximum absolute output-error trigger. When exceeded, capture a lossless trigger-local model/optimizer state anchor; no batch is rejected or modified.

retain_forward_outliers.description: Maximum number of strongest trigger-local forward-outlier bundles to retain.

val_enabled.description: Whether to enable validations. If disabled, all validation settings below are ignored.

save_img.description: Whether to save the validation images during validation, in the experiments/<name>/visualization folder.

save_img_iters.description: Optional training iterations at which validation images are saved. This filters image saving only; validation must still run at the iteration according to val_freq. Omit to save at every validation when save_img is enabled.

tile_size.description: Tile size of input to use during validation, reduce VRAM usage but slower inference. 0 to disable.

tile_overlap.description: Tile overlap to use during validation, larger is slower but reduces tile seams.

val_freq.description: How often to run validations, in iterations.

suffix.description: Optional suffix to append to saved filenames.

metrics_enabled.description: Whether to run metrics calculations during validation.

print_freq.description: How often to print logs to the console, in iterations.

save_checkpoint_freq.description: How often to save model checkpoints and training states, in iterations.

use_tb_logger.description: Whether or not to enable TensorBoard logging.
